value: Peter Pan Academy — Little Seeds & Peter Pan Schools

Peter Pan Academy offers a nurturing preschool experience rooted in play-based learning for children ages 2–5. Our warm, dedicated educators create a joyful space where every child feels seen, heard, and celebrated.
Toddlers explore independence through hands-on play, creative arts, and guided social interactions in small nurturing groups.
Project-based learning inspired by Reggio Emilia, where children investigate real questions through art, science, and storytelling.
Kindergarten-readiness skills woven into rich play experiences — literacy, numeracy, and executive function through joyful learning.
Extended care available for enrolled families. Children enjoy guided activities, outdoor play, and a healthy snack in a relaxed afternoon environment.
